newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oil companies bid for Barents Sea acreage.
newsitem.headline: Oil companies bid for Barents Sea acreage.

text.p: The Norwegian Oil and Energy Ministry said on Wednesday it had received nine applications for licences under the Barents Sea licensing project.
Ten companies had applied inidividually or in groups in all the areas offered in the round, the ministry said.
The oil companies are Agip, Amerada Hess, Elf Petroleum, Enterprise Oil, Norsk Hydro, Mobil, Neste, Phillips Petroleum, Saga Petroleum and Den norske stats oljeselskap.
"I am very pleased with the interest which the companies have shown in the Barents Sea project," said Norwegian Energy Minister Ranveig Froeiland in a statement.
"The project will provide a basis for further exploration in the area, and the positive consequences that may have for Norwegian revenues and employment in the northern region."
The ministry said 45 blocks in the Southern Barents Sea were up for allocation.
